subject.reader_scope: OLP-0004 through OLP-0026; complete Sets, Relations, and Functions chapters; 23 of 722 corpus units

method.interaction: visual inspection plus DOM-backed viewport, asset, overflow, disclosure, citation, and console checks

visual_cases.case: reader masthead and table of contents
visual_cases.observed: Telugu title and scope notice shape cleanly; the 23-entry table of contents uses the correct Telugu chapter labels సమితులు, సంబంధాలు, and ప్రమేయాలు.
Vertices, loop, arrows, surrounding Telugu prose, caption, and MathML are legible, centered, and unclipped.
Root and branch structure, labels, caption, and surrounding Telugu prose are legible and unclipped.
Domain and codomain shapes, elements, arrows, caption, and adjacent definition block render cleanly.
All three sets, solid and dashed arrows, caption, prose, and formulae remain legible at desktop and 390-pixel widths.
The visible 1965 citation in OLP-0013 navigates to #bib-Benacerraf1965 and lands on the matching References entry.
Canonical English source · OLP-0004 expands through its native details control, exposes the English heading, and reports an expanded accessibility state.
At 390 by 844 pixels the masthead and contents reflow to one column; Telugu text, MathML, and the complex composition diagram remain inside the viewport.

finding: No visual, interaction, asset-loading, console, or responsive-layout defect was observed in the deployed 23-unit reader.
